cohort: 32 active BTC-5m events / 64 observed tokens from exactly three preregistered 08 UTC development hours; no date or event substitution
end_rule: Use planned 5-minute end implied by embedded slug start+300s only when official event/market end corroborates; record both sources and mismatch. Decision t=end-120s.
identity_rule: Require embedded event_slug plus two observed token IDs and unique print market condition; verify against official Gamma event/market and CLOB by-token endpoints. Do not infer Up from token order.
label_rule: Use CTF payoutNumerators(0,1), payoutDenominator and getCollectionId/getPositionId with USDC.e to bind token to outcome index; current Gamma outcomePrices/closed/last trade are not labels. Label publication time unknown unless separately proven.
publication: Private per-event table and raw API/RPC replies stay gitignored; public only daily counts, intersection, failures and evidence hashes.
quote_rule: Latest received raw price_change direct BBO for verified Up token at or before t; age <=1000ms, then numeric/cross/conflict check. Separate latest full book snapshot top at or before t with age<=5000ms. No fallback to older valid row; no future event-time sort.
